title: Blue Owl funds take 80% of Meta's ~$27B Hyperion data center

sources.quote: The funds managed by Blue Owl Capital made a cash contribution of approximately $7 billion to the joint venture, and Meta received a one-time distribution from the joint venture in the amount of approximately $3 billion.

The parties have committed to fund their respective pro rata share of the approximately $27 billion in total development costs for the buildings and long-lived power, cooling, and connectivity infrastructure at the campus.

explain: Blue Owl's funds own 80% of a joint venture building Meta's Hyperion AI campus in Louisiana; Meta keeps 20% and leases all the buildings from the venture. Blue Owl put in about $7 billion of cash up front (shown here) and agreed to fund its 80% share of roughly $27 billion in total costs, partly with bonds sold to PIMCO and others.
